blocks.md: Push predicates down to data source. Filter early = fewer rows to join/aggregate. CTEs, views, subqueries — all can block or allow pushdown. NOT MATERIALIZED = pushdown enabled. MATERIALIZED/volatile = pushdown blocked.

blocks.md: Rule of thumb: Single reference + no volatile = NOT MATERIALIZED (pushdown). Multiple refs OR volatile = MATERIALIZED. Default in PG 12+ is smart.

items.explain: Volatile functions (NOW(), random()) force materialization to ensure consistent results per execution.

items.explain: Multiple references → materialized once, then scanned multiple times (avoids recomputation).

blocks.label: advanced recursive patterns
blocks.code:
-- Cycle detection with path tracking
WITH RECURSIVE paths AS (
  SELECT id, parent_id, name, ARRAY[id] AS path, 1 AS depth
  FROM nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT n.id, n.parent_id, n.name, p.path || n.id, p.depth + 1
  FROM nodes n
  JOIN paths p ON n.parent_id = p.id
  WHERE n.id != ALL(p.path)  -- cycle prevention
  AND p.depth < 20
)
SELECT * FROM paths;

-- Shortest path (BFS via level)
WITH RECURSIVE bfs AS (
  SELECT id, ARRAY[id] AS path, 0 AS dist
  FROM nodes WHERE id = 'A'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT n.id, p.path || n.id, p.dist + 1
  FROM edges e
  JOIN bfs p ON e.from_id = p.id
  JOIN nodes n ON e.to_id = n.id
  WHERE n.id != ALL(p.path)
  AND p.dist < 10
)
SELECT * FROM bfs WHERE id = 'Z' ORDER BY path LIMIT 1;

-- Transitive closure (all reachable)
WITH RECURSIVE reachable AS (
  SELECT from_id, to_id FROM edges WHERE from_id = 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT r.from_id, e.to_id
  FROM reachable r
  JOIN edges e ON e.from_id = r.to_id
  WHERE e.to_id != ALL(ARRAY[r.from_id] || r.to_id)
)
SELECT DISTINCT to_id FROM reachable;

glossary.def: Moving WHERE filter down into view/CTE/subquery to reduce rows before join.
CTE in PostgreSQL — materialized by default, blocks predicate pushdown and join reordering.
PostgreSQL 12+ hint to inline CTE, enabling predicate pushdown.
Force CTE to be computed once and stored; avoids recomputation for multiple references.
All reachable nodes from a starting node in a graph.
